visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young toddler with short dark hair is crouched on a grey tiled floor, partially hidden behind a white vertical-slatted baby gate and a white wall corner. The toddler, wearing a light yellow patterned short-sleeved shirt and dark shorts, peers around the corner of the wall with a neutral expression. The hallway setting features soft indoor lighting from above, casting gentle shadows. A large reflective silver or grey surface is visible on the right, mirroring the toddler's position. (2) The toddler begins to physically squeeze through the narrow gap between the end of the white baby gate and the interior wall. Their small hands grip the floor and the gate's frame as they navigate the tight space. The camera follows the movement in a slightly shaky handheld manner, maintaining a medium shot. The environment remains consistent with white walls and a clean tiled floor. (3) The toddler successfully maneuvers their torso and legs through the gap. A large golden-colored dog, likely a golden retriever, enters the frame from the left, its head and torso visible as it watches the child. The child continues crawling on all fours toward the foreground. Red graphic arrows appear on the screen, highlighting the child's legs during the process. (4) The toddler completes the crawl and sits upright on the floor, now fully on the other side of the gate. They look up toward the camera with a curious expression. The dog remains in the background, sniffing the floor near the gate. Brightly colored confetti-like graphics and party popper icons appear around the toddler as they sit successfully in the open hallway space.
